name: Caloriemate Dev Container
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; go mod download || true; npm ci --prefix frontend || true; command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm i -g pnpm; pnpm --prefix frontend install || true'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'echo Project available at: $VSCODE_DEV_CONTAINER_WORKSPACE_FOLDER or /workspaces/caloriemate; ls -la /workspaces/caloriemate'
